title: CoVA: Composing VAE Representations for Generative Learning
summary: Representation alignment with pretrained visual encoders improves diffusion transformer training but requires auxiliary encoders and extra training overhead. Recent approaches instead exploit representations from the generative model's own variational autoencoder (VAE). However, reconstruction-oriented VAE features are not optimized for the semantic discrimination and spatial structure needed for generative learning. We introduce \textbf{CoVA} (\textbf{Co}mposed \textbf{VA}E Representations), a lightweight framework that composes VAE features online into stage-wise guidance for flow-matching training. A small latent composer is jointly trained with class supervision, masked latent reconstruction, and horizontal-flip consistency, yielding semantically discriminative, spatially structured dense features and sample-dependent class posteriors. CoVA aligns intermediate SiT features with the composed representations early in training, then removes the increasingly detrimental alignment and reuses detached composer posteriors for sample-dependent soft label conditioning. We further uncover a hidden confound in soft label conditioning: averaging class embeddings attenuates their magnitude, coupling semantic interpolation with conditioning strength. This attenuation alone can substantially improve FID while degrading Recall, revealing a non-semantic source of the apparent gain. CoVA corrects this confound by restoring the hard-label magnitude, isolating posterior-dependent directional semantics. CoVA adds only 8.5M training-only auxiliary parameters (1.3\% of SiT-XL/2) and introduces no inference-time overhead. On ImageNet 256$\times$256, CoVA reduces SiT-XL/2 FID from 17.2 to 7.4 (\textbf{57\%}) in 400K steps. With classifier-free guidance, it achieves an FID of \textbf{2.03} in only 400 epochs, versus 2.06 after 1,400 epochs for vanilla SiT-XL/2.

title: LETHE: Defending against Unauthorized Image-to-Video Generation via Value Diversity Collapse
summary: Image-to-video (I2V) diffusion models can animate a single reference image into high-quality, subject-consistent videos, posing threats of misuse as anyone can turn personal photos into fabricated videos without consent. A promising solution is to proactively add an adversarial perturbation to the image before release, such that videos generated from it would be unfaithful or visually corrupted. However, due to an insufficient understanding of what governs how subsequent frames read the reference image in modern I2V models, existing protections struggle to offer strong protection under common perturbation budgets. In this paper, we approach the problem by exploring this underlying reading mechanism. Through a convex geometric analysis, we theoretically identify the spread of the reference value vectors as a key factor governing this reading process, and empirically find that even a mild contraction of this spread can severely degrade the generated video, making it an efficient lever for protection. Guided by this insight, we propose LETHE, a novel protection method that directly disrupts this reading process. LETHE pairs two complementary objectives, where a value collapse objective drives the reference value vectors toward uniformity, while an attention attraction objective draws subsequent frames toward these collapsed tokens to amplify corruption. We further construct two human-centric I2V protection benchmarks and conduct extensive experiments with multiple modern I2V models, which demonstrate the state-of-the-art protection performance and versatility of LETHE.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 I2V 扩散模型如何「读取」参考图像，通过凸几何分析指出参考 value 向量分布的离散度是主导因素，据此提出 LETHE 保护方法，联合 value collapse 与 attention attraction 两个目标破坏该读取过程，并构建两个人类中心基准加以验证。

title: AgentTune: A Unified Training Lifecycle for Tool-Using LLM Agents
summary: Tool-using agents increasingly require a common substrate for building, training, evaluating, distilling, and maintaining agentic systems, yet existing tooling typically addresses these stages in isolation. We present AgentTune, a source-available Python library that provides a unified framework for developing and optimizing tool-using agents. At its core, AgentTune introduces a two-tier EventLog representation that preserves agent trajectories while supporting consistent projections for training, evaluation, and auditing. Building on this substrate, the library provides a shared agent runtime, tool-calling reinforcement learning, agentic distillation, retrieval-augmented generation, decision workflows, evaluation utilities, and a designed path toward self-healing agents. These components are exposed through composable interfaces so that agent strategies, training methods, evaluation procedures, and recovery mechanisms can be combined without requiring separate representations or pipelines. We demonstrate the framework across agentic tasks including legal contract search and domain-specific applications, illustrating its use for trajectory-based optimization, tool-use evaluation, and cross-task agent development. AgentTune is released as a source-available library at https://github.com/Lexsi-Labs/AgentTune

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 AgentTune，一个面向工具调用 LLM agent 的开源 Python 库，用两层 EventLog 统一表示 agent 轨迹，并整合共享运行时、工具调用 RL、蒸馏、RAG、评估与自愈等组件。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「轨迹统一表示＋可投影到训练/评估」的设计，可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练、监督与贡献分配提供工程线索，但该库针对纯文本工具 agent，与 latent 视觉状态是否兼容有待核查。

title: Exploring Attention Sinks in Text-to-Image Transformers from Diffusion and Autoregressive Models
summary: Attention sinks are tokens or positions that consistently receive disproportionate attention mass, often beyond what their semantic content would suggest. Despite extensive study in large language models, their behavior and functional relevance in text-to-image (T2I) Transformers remain largely unexplored. To fill this gap and better understand how text-to-image Transformers allocate and route attention, we explore this phenomenon of text-to-image transformers across bidirectional diffusion models and causal autoregressive models. Specifically, we explore whether attention sinks exist, where they emerge, and how they functionally influence generation. Through systematic attention analysis and targeted interventions, we identify that attention sinks emerge in both bidirectional diffusion and autoregressive models but exhibit distinct patterns. The autoregressive model concentrates attention on the first and global-scale tokens, whereas the bidirectional models develop sinks near modality boundaries, within text regions, and at spatial corners. Moreover, these patterns vary across generation stages and are localized to a sparse subset of layers and heads. To assess their functional relevance, we perturb sink-related heads and token positions. It turns out that perturbing sink-ranked heads produces larger average changes than non-sink comparisons, while some sink-position perturbations have limited effects on bidirectional model scores. We further introduce register tokens to redistribute attention sinks and find that several configurations preserve or modestly improve generation performance. Overall, attention sinks are architecture-, inference-stage-, and component-dependent phenomena, providing a basis for mechanistic analysis and principled attention design in text-to-image transformers.

AI.brief_summary: 论文系统考察 text-to-image Transformer 中的 attention sink 现象：在双向 diffusion 与因果 autoregressive 模型中定位 sink 出现的位置、跨生成阶段的分布及集中的少数层与头，并通过扰动 sink 相关头与 token 位置、引入 register token 重分配注意力，检验其功能作用。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「定位注意力 sink 再施加干预以判断功能重要性」的分析流程，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据如何被注意力路由、哪些头或位置对推理状态有真实因果贡献；但研究对象是图像生成而非多模态推理，迁移线索需人工验证。

title: SWE-Critix: Post-Training Generalist Verifiers for Assessing Coding-Agent Trajectories
summary: Coding agents are increasingly deployed for end-to-end software engineering tasks, where a readily available oracle evaluator that defines the success criteria is often absent. This motivates verifications for coding agents that can reliably judge and explain their behavior. However, verification is non-trivial as coding agents are increasingly capable of solving long-horizon software engineering tasks. Their execution trajectories can be extremely long, containing hundreds of iterative interactions with code repositories and external tools. Existing verifiers either rely on general-purpose LLMs without specialized training or train dedicated critics that predominantly focus on producing scalar rewards, highlighting the relatively limited exploration of training-based generalist verification. We introduce SWE-Critix, a post-training pipeline for training generalist verifiers of coding-agent trajectories. Given a task and its execution trajectory, the learned verifier predicts the completion label and generates a natural-language analysis that explains its judgment. Our pipeline combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with reinforcement learning (RL) and trains a series of 30B models on trajectories from CodeForge-Preview. On a held-out test set, SWE-Critix improves classification accuracy from 57% for the base Qwen3-30B-A3B reasoning model to 66% after SFT and 78% after RL. We release our models, datasets, and training code to facilitate further research.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SWE-Critix，用 SFT 加 RL 的后训练流程训练 30B 通用验证器，对编码智能体的长程执行轨迹预测完成标签并生成自然语言判断分析，留出测试集上分类准确率由基座的 57% 提升到 78%。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 的视觉推理主线不直接相关，但轨迹级验证器的后训练与监督设计，可能为 latent 推理中的过程监督、贡献分配以及停止/验证决策提供可核查的方法线索。

title: Opening the Black Box of Classifier-Free Guidance via Information Bottleneck
summary: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is a standard technique for improving conditional generation in diffusion models, yet its activation schedule is usually selected heuristically. In practice, most existing CFG-based methods rely on a pre-defined activation policy throughout inference, while recent dynamic variants often depend on hand-designed schedules without a principled theoretical explanation of when conditional information is most useful. In order to understand how the informational relevance between conditioning inputs and the score function evolves over the course of generation, we explore when guidance should be activated from an information-theoretic perspective. In this work, we formulate the diffusion trajectory as a time-dependent information bottleneck and show that the effectiveness of conditional information is not uniform throughout sampling, but becomes significantly stronger after a critical stage characterized by a Fisher-information balance condition. Motivated by this insight, we propose a training-free dynamic CFG strategy for inference. Rather than prescribing a fixed schedule in advance, our method constructs a stochastic process from conditional and unconditional score statistics and activates guidance when the estimated guidance gain crosses a prescribed threshold. This yields an adaptive activation rule that aligns condition injection with the underlying generation dynamics, while also recovering interval-based guidance as a limiting special case. Extensive experiments across diverse architectures and tasks, demonstrate that our method is effective, robust, and broadly applicable. Beyond empirical improvements, our framework provides an interpretation of dynamic guidance methods and a principled foundation for inference-time control in conditional diffusion models.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把扩散采样轨迹建模为时间相关的信息瓶颈，发现条件信息的效用并非全程均匀，而是在以 Fisher 信息平衡条件为标志的关键阶段之后显著增强，并据此提出免训练的动态 CFG 策略：由条件与无条件 score 统计构造随机过程，在估计的引导增益越过阈值时才激活引导，区间式引导为其极限特例。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「何时注入条件信息」的增益估计与阈值门控机制可供核查，可能为 VLM 推理中视觉证据注入时机与延迟/停止决策提供类比，但该文面向扩散图像生成，迁移到推理期状态更新只是推测。

title: Local Diagnostics of Learned Event Representations for Anomaly Detection at the HL-LHC
summary: Anomaly detection, the identification of collision events that deviate from Standard Model expectations, is one of the most promising model-agnostic strategies for new-physics searches at the Large Hadron Collider. Searching for rare events in learned low-dimensional representations removes the need to commit to hand-crafted observables a priori, but sacrifices the immediate physical interpretation those observables provide. For anomaly detection to enter a discovery pipeline, flagged events must therefore be diagnosed locally, both to distinguish potential new physics from mismodeling or detector effects and to identify observables for targeted follow-up searches. We evaluate supervised and self-supervised neural embedding strategies on COLLIDE-2V, a 750-million-event dataset simulated under realistic High-Luminosity LHC conditions, using the reconstruction error of an autoencoder trained in the learned latent space as the anomaly score. Across the configurations and benchmark signals considered, supervised objectives, which exploit simulation process labels during training, generally outperform their self-supervised counterparts and, in their best configurations, improve on an autoencoder trained directly on kinematic features, raising the signal efficiency at 10% background acceptance on all held-out processes. We further introduce a local diagnostic pipeline that fits a Gaussian Mixture Model to the SM latent space, profiles each component through high-level observables without process labels, localizes the flagged events, and ranks observables by their local discriminating power. The ranking recovers the defining kinematics of the held-out processes, while correlating the anomaly score with the same observables quantifies how closely the score tracks them, revealing cases where the most discriminating observable is not the one the score follows most closely.

AI.brief_summary: 该文在 HL-LHC 的 COLLIDE-2V 大规模模拟数据上比较监督与自监督神经嵌入用于异常检测，以在学得潜空间中训练的自编码器重构误差作异常分数，并提出局部诊断流程：对 SM 潜空间拟合 GMM、无过程标签地用高层观测量刻画各成分、定位被标记事件并排序观测量的局部判别力。
AI.relevance_reason: 其潜空间诊断线索（GMM 成分刻画、观测量判别力排序，以及异常分数与观测量相关的对比，揭示「最有判别力的观测量并非分数最追随者」）可能可迁移到 LVR 中核查 latent 状态是否真正驱动输出、贡献分配与证据筛选的思路，但领域与目标差异较大，属方法借鉴而非直接相关。

title: Rollout-Time Intervention: Unlocking Agentic Reinforcement Learning Beyond Policy Limits
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a key paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) agents, enabling stronger reasoning, planning, and tool-use in interactive environments. However, existing agent RL methods remain fundamentally constrained by an on-policy reasoning bottleneck: when tasks exceed the model's current capability boundary, effective trajectories become extremely sparse and training often collapses. We introduce Rollout-Time Intervention (RTI), a technique designed to elicit successful trajectories beyond the policy's intrinsic exploration capacity. RTI operates by leveraging reward-side evidence (i.e., evaluation rubrics) during rollout to convert erroneous trajectories into successful ones, providing effective learning signals for tasks that the policy rarely solves on its own. Although intervention trajectories are inherently off-policy, we find that they can effectively guide policy optimization when trajectories with excessive distributional shifts are filtered out. Extensive experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that RTI consistently outperforms RL baselines, enabling the post-trained policy to approach the performance of substantially stronger contemporary LLMs and, more importantly, transcend its original capability boundary. The code is available at https://github.com/Alibaba-NLP/qqr.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Rollout-Time Intervention（RTI）：在 rollout 阶段利用奖励侧的评价规则（rubrics）把错误轨迹改写为成功轨迹，并对分布偏移过大的干预轨迹加以过滤，从而在策略自身难以解出的任务上获得有效学习信号，在五个基准上超过 RL 基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文的轨迹级干预与 off-policy 过滤思路，可能为 LVR 中轨迹训练、监督信号来源与贡献分配提供可借鉴的方法线索，但其面向纯文本 agent RL、不含视觉状态或推理期 latent 生成，与主线的实际关联仍需核查。

title: Branching On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories, but a single trajectory realizes only one continuation at each decision, limiting supervision coverage under a finite sampling budget. We propose BranchOPD (Branching On-Policy Distillation), which selects informative decision points using student uncertainty and teacher-student disagreement, resamples student-policy continuations from shared prefixes, and applies token-level teacher supervision to both main trajectories and branches. BranchOPD operates at token-level decisions in mathematics and within-turn decisions in agent tasks. Shared-prefix reuse reduces student-generated token costs by approximately 19% on ALFWorld and 31% on WebShop relative to seven independent trajectories. We also introduce protocol-boundary repair (PBR), which uses targeted supervision under protocol constraints to mitigate repetition and wasted generation. BranchOPD outperforms Vanilla OPD and Multi-Rollout OPD (n=7) across all evaluated benchmarks, with gains over Vanilla OPD of 18.55 percentage points in mean mathematics accuracy over 16 sampled answers (avg@16) and 13.8 points in mean ALFWorld ID/OOD success. Mechanistic analyses and selection ablations show that branching at uncertain decisions expands subsequent behavior coverage and outperforms random selection and turn-initial branching.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 BranchOPD：用学生不确定性与师生分歧挑选决策点，从共享前缀重采样学生策略分支并对主轨迹和分支施加 token 级教师监督，另加协议边界修复，在数学与 ALFWorld/WebShop 上降低生成开销并提升准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 按不确定性选择分支点、共享前缀复用与教师分歧信号，可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练、监督贡献分配及推理成本核算提供可核查的方法线索，但论文不涉及视觉或多模态推理。

title: SplatQ: Interaction-Aware Pruning of 3D Gaussian Splatting via Quadratic Selection
comment: Under review at ICLR 2027 (main paper 9 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables; appendix included)
summary: Existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pruning methods primarily rely on global Top-K selection based on independent importance scores, lacking regional budget control and ignoring joint deletion effects. Consequently, they cannot ensure balanced reconstruction quality across a scene. We propose SplatQ, a combinatorial pruning algorithm that coordinates regional budget allocation and joint Gaussian selection under a fixed budget. SplatQ partitions Gaussians by spatial proximity and appearance similarity into size-limited blocks, decomposing global selection into subproblems of a specific size. It then smooths importance-based block retention quotas to prevent excessive budget concentration. Finally, it constructs a quadratic approximation of joint deletion effects using the responses of representative pixel colors to changes in Gaussian opacity. Individual responses, pairwise interactions, and quota penalties are incorporated into a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) objective, solved using simulated annealing (SA) or a coherent Ising machine (CIM) to jointly select Gaussians. Experiments on 5 benchmarks demonstrate that SplatQ outperforms state-of-the-art pruning methods in aggregate reconstruction quality, spatial quality balance, and rendering speed. Ablations confirm that budget smoothing improves local detail reconstruction, while interaction modeling improves Gaussian selection quality under a fixed budget.

AI.brief_summary: SplatQ 针对 3D Gaussian Splatting 的剪枝，指出仅靠独立重要度做全局 Top-K 忽略了联合删除效应，改用分块+预算平滑+基于像素响应的二次交互建模，将固定预算下的选择写成 QUBO 并求解。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「预算约束下联合选择、显式建模成对交互而非独立打分」的思路，可能可供核查用于 LVR 中的视觉证据/token 筛选与预算分配；但对象是 3D 渲染资产而非推理状态，迁移性需人工判断。

title: Beyond Temporal Proximity: Explanatory World Models for Credit Assignment in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Generative Recommenders increasingly use Reinforcement Learning (RL) to optimize outcomes that may appear hundreds or thousands of interactions after a decision. Standard RL propagates reward according to temporal proximity rather than explicit relevance, attenuating the signal assigned to distant but important actions and creating a source of sample inefficiency. We introduce Explanatory World Models (EWM), an attribution framework that uses explanations to identify the earlier events that plausibly contributed to a realized outcome. We instantiate EWM with a frontier language model and use its explanations as learning signals using a conservative hierarchical operator that recursively redistributes reward while preserving the undiscounted episode return. To investigate what constitutes a useful explanation, we operationalize three complementary variants inspired by Halpern's actual causation, Lombrozo's explanatory simplicity, and Deutsch's hard-to-vary explanations. We evaluate EWM on two controlled long-horizon RL benchmarks, a public sequential-recommendation benchmark, and an industry-scale generative recommender. On Crafter and WordCraft, EWM substantially outperforms PPO and LaRe, with its largest gains when rewards are most delayed. On KuaiRand, EWM outperforms SFT and LaRe offline and A2C online. Finally, in an offline evaluation of an industry generative recommender, EWM considerably improves Recall and increases behavioral proxies. These results suggest that explanations can provide structured and reusable credit for learning from delayed outcomes.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对长时程 RL 中按时间邻近度传播奖励导致的远距离信用分配失效问题，提出 Explanatory World Models：用前沿语言模型生成解释，识别可能促成结果的早期事件，并以保持回合回报不变的保守层级算子递归重分配奖励；在 Crafter、WordCraft、KuaiRand 及工业生成式推荐器上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽属推荐系统 RL 领域，但其「用语言模型解释定位真正起作用的前置步骤并重分配奖励」的机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理步骤的贡献分配与稀疏监督提供可核查线索，尚需核实其归因是否依赖可读文本轨迹而非内部状态。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Multimodal Language Model with Heterogeneous Evidence Integration for Clinical Prognosis
summary: Clinical prognosis requires integrating structured measurements, physiological waveforms, longitudinal history, and population context. We introduce PRISM (Population-Retrieved Inference for Structured Multimodal Prognosis), a multimodal language model that combines per-feature numerical tokenization, recency-weighted aggregation of longitudinal ECGs, and a dual-modality population memory bank. Retrieval operates in representation space: the model receives mean-pooled embeddings of similar training-cohort encounters, while no individual retrieved record enters the prompt. On the 1,443-task MDS-ED benchmark, PRISM achieves AUROCs of 86.2% for diagnosis, 93.1% for deterioration, 91.8% for ICU admission, and 92.8% for mortality. These results use a 96-hour pre-arrival window unavailable to reported baselines. With benchmark-window inputs only, PRISM reaches 0.8895 AUROC, compared with 0.8937 for UniPACT and 0.8889 for MDS-ED. A matched-input compact fusion model using the same five evidence streams and frozen encoders reaches 0.7652 AUROC, versus 0.9092 for PRISM. Replacing numerical EHR encoding with text serialization reduces AUROC by 3.66 points; removing pre-arrival history reduces it by 1.97 points; and zeroing retrieval reduces it by 0.99 points. Genuine retrieval outperforms random-neighbor retrieval by 0.97 macro-average points, although a paired task-level sign test does not establish a uniform advantage (p=0.067). On the external MC-MED cohort, supervised fine-tuning reaches 0.8611 AUROC, compared with 0.8227 for locally trained gradient boosting and 0.7841 for source-only PRISM. These results support structure-aware multimodal integration and supervised external adaptation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PRISM，一个面向临床预后预测的多模态语言模型，通过逐特征数值分词、纵向 ECG 的时近加权聚合与双模态人群记忆库检索来整合异构证据。
AI.relevance_reason: 其检索在表示空间完成、相似样本的池化嵌入直接进入模型而不进入 prompt，这一潜在证据注入方式可供核查 LVR 中外部证据如何写入 latent 状态、是否形成旁路；但数据为临床而非视觉模态，迁移性需自行判断。

title: Beyond Domain-Routed Supervision: Cross-Teacher Guarding for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
comment: 30 pages, 9 figures, 10 tables, including references and appendices
summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) extends on-policy distillation (OPD) by routing domain-specific data to specialized teachers, integrating their capabilities through dense token-level supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, domain routing only distinguishes the supervision sources for different domains; updates from all domains still act on shared parameters. When teachers differ substantially in response style and domain expertise, supervision that is effective in isolation may still lead to persistent gradient conflicts and capability degradation during joint optimization. To address this challenge, we propose Cross-Teacher Guarding for MOPD (Road MOPD), which introduces non-routed teachers as auxiliary cross-domain critics on the same student trajectories and coordinates multi-teacher supervision through token-level credit assignment and gradient updates. Specifically, cross-teacher-guided credit assignment uses teacher agreement to strengthen token-level corrections jointly supported by the teachers and attenuate conflicting signals; preventive multi-teacher gradient projection uses auxiliary gradients from the same trajectories to constrain potentially conflicting updates and adaptively controls projection strength to retain target-domain learning signals. In experiments, Road MOPD mitigates degradation in the disadvantaged domain, gains over 5 percentage points under high conflict, and improves overall performance in low-conflict and three-domain settings.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Road MOPD：把未路由的跨域教师当作辅助批评者，在同一学生轨迹上用 token 级信用分配与多教师梯度投影协调多教师 on-policy 蒸馏，以缓解联合优化时的梯度冲突与能力退化。
AI.relevance_reason: 属纯文本蒸馏工作，但其依教师一致性做的 token 级信用分配与冲突更新投影，可能为 LVR 中多源监督的贡献分配、冲突信号抑制和推理轨迹训练提供可核查的方法线索。

title: Learning Holistic Scene Layout against View Shifts in Cross-View Geo-Localization
summary: Cross-view geo-localization remains challenging due to drastic appearance variations and geometric distortions caused by viewpoint changes. Existing methods primarily rely on discriminative feature learning or explicit geometric alignment, yet often overlook an important observation: humans tend to match scenes by integrating the spatial context of multiple landmarks rather than relying solely on isolated local visual cues. Inspired by this, we propose a Spatial Context Modeling (SCM) module, which traverses feature maps along four orthogonal directions and models interactions among the resulting directional representations at each spatial position. By aggregating complementary directional observations, SCM constructs richer scene layout representations. Since reliable spatial context depends on robust visual features, we introduce a High-Frequency Information Guidance (HFIG) module that extracts stable structural cues from the frequency domain. By emphasizing edges and contours that are less sensitive to appearance variations, HFIG encourages the model to learn more robust representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves competitive performance on standard cross-view geo-localization benchmarks while exhibiting strong robustness under more challenging scenarios with unknown orientations and limited fields of view (FoVs).

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SCM 模块沿四个正交方向遍历特征图并建模各方向表示间的交互，以构建整体场景布局表示，并引入 HFIG 从频域提取对表观变化不敏感的边与轮廓结构线索，用于跨视角地理定位。
AI.relevance_reason: 方向感知的空间上下文聚合与频域结构引导，可能为 LVR 内部状态保留实体关系、几何布局和稳定视觉细节提供可核查线索；但该工作属检索式定位，不涉及推理状态生成与答案使用，迁移需自行判断。

title: Probabilistic Ship Trajectory Forecasting using Transformer Models on AIS Data
comment: Manuscript written in 2021. 16 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables
summary: Anticipation of vessel trajectories is an essential task when navigating at sea. This applies to both human navigators and autonomous surface vessels. Trajectory forecasting enables sub-routines such as collision avoidance to assess the situation and react accordingly in time. This paper investigates Transformer and Performer models for trajectory prediction of surface vessels in confined waters. Using widely available position data from the Automatic Identification System (AIS), candidate models are trained and evaluated. Historical information on how other vessels have moved in the local area surrounding each agent is conveyed using positional heat maps. The heat maps are generated using Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) and encoded with a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) before entering the Transformer models. The models are trained with quantile loss to efficiently obtain a model-aware prediction interval, as this is crucial for timely collision avoidance. The proposed model architectures are shown to greatly outperform previous work while the inclusion of local heat maps enables the prediction of vessel movement that is not otherwise indicated from the previous positions.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究受限水域内水面船舶的轨迹预测：用 AIS 位置数据训练 Transformer 与 Performer，将由核密度估计生成的局部位置热力图经 CNN 编码后一并输入模型，并以分位数损失训练以获得预测区间，报告性能优于先前工作。
AI.relevance_reason: CNN 编码的空间热力图作为额外通道注入 Transformer，可供核查 LVR 中空间证据如何进入推理状态、是否真被答案使用（对应视觉旁路与信息坍缩问题）；分位数损失给出的预测区间也可对照 STOP 决策与不确定性建模。属远领域方法线索，迁移可行性需读原文核实。

title: $L_0$ Feature Selection via Monte Carlo Tree Search in High-Dimensional Financial Regression
comment: Accepted at the 7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF '26). 8 pages, 2 figures
summary: Feature selection is a central problem in high-dimensional financial regression, where large numbers of engineered variables and strong correlations among predictors reduce model stability and interpretability. $L_1$ regularization (Lasso) is widely used for sparse regression, but its shrinkage can be restrictive when informative signals are spread across correlated variables. Exact sparse regression avoids this shrinkage but requires solving a combinatorial optimization problem that is computationally difficult and is typically fit to minimize in-sample rather than out-of-sample error. This paper presents a feature selection framework based on Monte Carlo Tree Search with Generalized Nested Rollout Policy Adaptation (GNRPA). Feature selection is formulated as a sequential decision process, and candidate subsets are scored by their out-of-sample validation performance rather than training error. The method also supports a lexicographic objective accounting for subset size and multicollinearity. We study this approach on a contemporaneous explanatory regression task: explaining the weekly return of the NASDAQ-100 index from 1,072 engineered features spanning market, macroeconomic, and factor data. This isolates the value of subset selection under multicollinearity from the separate problem of predictive forecasting. On this task, the proposed method identifies sparse feature subsets with higher out-of-sample explanatory power than an optimized Lasso baseline, reaching an out-of-sample $R^2$ of 0.6961 versus 0.6313 for Lasso. These results suggest that Monte Carlo Tree Search is a practical alternative to convex regularization for sparse explanatory feature selection in financial regression, with potential value for factor attribution and risk decomposition where transparency matters as much as out-of-sample fit.

AI.brief_summary: 论文将高维金融回归的特征选择建模为序贯决策过程，用蒙特卡洛树搜索结合 GNRPA 搜索稀疏特征子集，并以样本外验证表现而非训练误差作为打分准则，在 NASDAQ-100 周收益解释任务上优于 Lasso。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 MCTS＋rollout 策略自适应的序贯搜索与「以验证目标替代训练目标打分」的做法，可能为 latent 推理轨迹或视觉证据子集的搜索、以及何时停止扩展的决策提供方法线索，但金融回归与多模态推理的差距需核查。

title: MENTOR: Learning from Failure with On-Policy Pedagogical Intervention
summary: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is a key driver for Large Reasoning Models, but it is vulnerable to "zero-reward collapse", a training failure where a sudden increase in task difficulty causes the learning signal to vanish. We argue that the conventional approach of discarding these failed trajectories is wasteful, as they contain valuable diagnostic information about the model's cognitive gaps, a bright side that can be leveraged for recovery. Existing solutions, however, often regress to static, "off-policy-style" interventions like pre-defined hint libraries or perform post-hoc refinement, failing to provide the adaptive, forward-looking guidance needed to escape the collapse. To address this, we propose a paradigm shift towards on-policy pedagogical intervention and introduce MENTOR, a multi-agent framework that acts as a live mentor. MENTOR diagnoses the root cause of failure in real-time and dynamically generates targeted, instructional prompts to guide the learning agent's next attempt. As a plug-and-play module, MENTOR integrates seamlessly into existing policy optimization pipelines like GRPO without modifying the training infrastructure. Extensive experiments on math and code generation show that MENTOR effectively mitigates zero-reward collapse, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines. Notably, it achieves massive average relative gains of up to 78.3% on Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct over its base model.

AI.brief_summary: 针对 RLVR 训练中任务突然变难导致的「零奖励坍缩」，提出多智能体框架 MENTOR，实时诊断失败根因并动态生成教学式提示，以 on-policy 方式引导策略下一次尝试，可即插即用地嵌入 GRPO 等流程。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本训练侧工作，但其「失败轨迹含诊断信息 + on-policy 实时干预」的思路，可能为 latent 推理轨迹的监督与贡献分配、以及推理信号坍缩时的恢复提供可核查线索；与视觉状态表示无直接关系。

title: EchoTab: Learning Measurement-Grounded Representations for Echocardiographic Diagnosis through Tabular Reconstruction
summary:
Diagnostic information in multi-view medical imaging studies, like echocardiography, is distributed across views, each capturing different aspects of cardiac structure and function. In clinical practice, these views are first interpreted through quantitative measurements, which then support specific diagnoses. However, existing echo representation learning methods do not explicitly model measurements as an intermediate representation between views and diagnosis. As a result, individual measurements are not explicitly represented in a form that downstream diagnostic tasks can selectively use, hindering accurate diagnosis.
  Inspired by this hierarchical clinical workflow, we introduce EchoTab, a measurement-grounded representation learning framework that represents multi-view echocardiography studies using measurement-specific tokens as an intermediate representation between echo views and diagnosis. Each measurement token selectively attends to the views relevant to its estimation and is trained through tabular reconstruction to predict the corresponding measurement value. The resulting tokens form a factorized echo representation, which encode clinically meaningful structural and functional properties and can be selectively used for downstream diagnosis. Unlike the commonly used contrastive approaches, EchoTab does not require negative samples or large batch sizes. Experiments on two datasets demonstrate that EchoTab learns effective measurement-grounded representations that improve diagnosis classification in multi-view echocardiography and its learned attention aligns with established measurement-view relationships used by cardiologists. Our code is accessible at https://github.com/michelleespranita/EchoTab.

AI.brief_summary: EchoTab 用测量指标专属 token 作为多视角超声心动图视图与诊断之间的中间表示，每个 token 选择性关注相关视图，并通过表格重建预测对应测量值，形成可分解、可选择性调用的表示。
AI.relevance_reason: 测量 token 属于被重建任务直接监督的中间状态并可按需选取，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态监督与视觉证据筛选提供方法线索；但该工作属医学影像领域，能否迁移到 VLM 推理尚需核查。

title: Humanize Olympiad Agents: A Multi-Session Workflow for Olympiad Problem Solving with Solve, Review, Wiki, Verify
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are rapidly improving on long-horizon scientific and olympiad tasks. Recent systems have produced a Lean-formalized resolution of the Navier--Stokes problem and autonomous solutions to four open questions in the Erdős Conjectures database. Yet neither system releases both its underlying model and complete inference stack. More broadly, a single agent session remains brittle on difficult problems: early errors can propagate, missing domain knowledge can stall progress, and apparent success can mask a misinterpretation or weakening of the original task. We introduce HOA (Humanize Olympiads Agent), an open, flow-level framework that coordinates multiple agent sessions through three complementary feedback channels. First, an independent reviewer evaluates each candidate and provides actionable feedback. Second, a structured wiki supplies task-specific knowledge that may be missing or unreliable in model pretraining. Third, a verifier checks generated Lean proofs against trusted challenge statements. With GPT-5.6 Sol, HOA achieves perfect scores on the IMO, IPhO, and IOI 2026, near-full marks on the IChO 2026 problem set, and solves all 672 problems (100%) on PutnamBench. On the Lean-Eval leaderboard, HOA ranks first, solving 251 of 304 problems (82.6%). We further evaluate HOA with open models. Using Kimi-K3, HOA achieves full scores on the IMO, IPhO, and IOI, and a gold-level score of 97.1% on the IChO. These results closely match the closed-source GPT-5.6 Sol + /Goal baseline on the IMO and IPhO, while exceeding it on the IChO and IOI, demonstrating that systematic feedback can help bridge substantial differences in base-model capability.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 HOA，一个开放的多会话 agent 框架，用独立 reviewer、结构化 wiki 与 Lean 证明 verifier 三条反馈通道协调多次求解会话，并在 IMO、IPhO、IOI 等奥赛与 PutnamBench、Lean-Eval 上报告成绩。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本推理，不含视觉或 latent 状态，但其对外部 reviewer/verifier 反馈、早期错误传播与「表面成功掩盖任务弱化」的处理，可能为 LVR 中的验证、停止决策与监督信号设计提供可核查线索。

title: A Step Harder, Not a Step Too Far: The Benefits and Limits of Curriculum Difficulty Progression in GRPO
summary: Curriculum learning typically organizes training samples from easy to hard. In GRPO, medium-difficulty samples are attractive for online selection because they are more likely to yield informative group-relative learning signals, and prioritizing them can improve training efficiency. However, it remains unclear whether persistently selecting such samples also leads to the strongest final model performance, or whether training can benefit from progressing toward harder samples. Meanwhile, sample difficulty changes as the policy evolves, so fixed difficulty estimates can become misaligned with the current policy. We therefore re-estimate sample difficulty under the current policy and, inspired by the easy-to-hard principle of curriculum learning, design and evaluate a staged curriculum that progressively shifts the active difficulty band toward harder samples. Experiments on GSM8K show that persistent medium-difficulty selection does not achieve the strongest observed performance. Across three random seeds, progressing to a moderately harder difficulty band improves test accuracy to $0.6591 \pm 0.0077$, compared with $0.6449 \pm 0.0024$ for the fixed-medium curriculum. However, further progression to a harder difficulty band reduces accuracy to $0.6405 \pm 0.0053$. These results show that staged difficulty progression can outperform persistent medium-difficulty selection, but its benefit is non-monotonic. Effective GRPO curricula can therefore benefit from progressing beyond medium difficulty, while avoiding excessive progression toward overly difficult samples.}

AI.brief_summary: 该工作研究 GRPO 中课程难度递进对最终性能的影响：在当前策略下重新估计样本难度，并设计分阶段课程将活跃难度带逐步移向更难样本；GSM8K 上适度的难度推进优于持续选择中等难度，但进一步变难反而使准确率下降，收益呈非单调。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文为纯文本 RL 推理训练，未涉及视觉或 latent 状态，但其「随策略演化重估难度、按难度分阶段选择训练样本」的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹训练的信号筛选与监督分配提供可核查线索。

title: VQIL: Visible Quantum Interference Learning for Perturbation Response Ranking on Graphs
summary: Learning how local perturbations affect a network is important for identifying which components drive or absorb a system's response. We formulate this as seed-conditioned response ranking: given a perturbation at one seed node, ranking all other nodes by response strength. This is challenging when the model is given only the interaction topology, while the mechanism governing how perturbations propagate must be learned from data. We present VQIL (Visible Quantum Interference Learning), a trainable Szegedy quantum walk for seed-conditioned ranking. Edge weights, link phases, and per-node phase rotations are optimized end-to-end by backpropagation while the walk operator remains unitary throughout training. Node scores are obtained from a geometrically discounted coherent sum of quantum-walk amplitudes, enabling quantum interference before the final squared-norm readout. Because each learned parameter is attached to a named edge or node, the trained model provides directly inspectable hypotheses about the roles of individual graph components in the propagation mechanism. On AC power-flow perturbations over six transmission grids, with electrical parameters withheld from the model, VQIL improves Spearman rank correlation from 0.147 for the untrained walk to 0.831 and outperforms an identically trained random-walk model. On gene perturbation over five protein-protein interaction networks with Perturb-seq supervision, VQIL improves rank correlation from 0.171 to 0.620, outperforming the strongest learned classical and neural baselines. These results show that trainable quantum-walk interference provides a scalable and interpretable inductive bias for learning seed-conditioned response rankings on graphs.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 VQIL，将「给定扰动种子节点、对其余节点按响应强度排序」建模为可训练的 Szegedy 量子游走：端到端优化边权、连边相位与逐节点相位旋转，保持游走算子幺正，并在平方范数读出前用几何折扣的相干振幅求和实现干涉；在六个输电网潮流扰动与五个 PPI 网络基因扰动上验证排序相关性提升，参数可逐边逐点检视。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉/多模态推理无直接关系，但其可微的幺正状态演化加读出前相干干涉与几何折扣聚合，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹的循环更新、跨步加权与状态坍缩问题提供方法线索，可供核查。

title: Variance-Reduced Policy Gradient is Nearly Minimax-Optimal
summary: Standard Policy Gradient (PG) algorithms suffer from high estimation variance because they rely on Monte Carlo updates. While off-policy variance reduction mitigates this problem, establishing optimal sample complexity currently requires either restrictive assumptions, such as uniformly bounded importance weights, or impractical second-order operations. In this work, we introduce Loopless Variance-Reduced PG (LVR-PG), a unified theoretical framework that abstracts a class of first-order estimators that integrate recursive updates with defensive importance sampling, including known estimators such as PAGE-PG and STORM-PG. We prove that this algorithmic class achieves $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(ε^{-2})$ last-iterate global convergence under weak gradient domination for general parametric policies. We establish this guarantee using purely first-order updates, with minimal assumptions and without gradient preconditioners. By extending state-of-the-art lower bounds to continuous parametric policies, we establish an $Ω(ε^{-2})$ sample complexity limit, confirming our framework is minimax-optimal up to logarithmic factors and horizon terms.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LVR-PG 理论框架，用一阶递归更新结合防御性重要性采样统一了 PAGE-PG、STORM-PG 等估计器，并在弱梯度支配下证明 Õ(ε⁻²) 的 last-iterate 全局收敛，同时给出 Ω(ε⁻²) 下界说明其 minimax 最优。
AI.relevance_reason: 其递归式方差缩减一阶估计与防御性重要性采样，可能为长 latent 推理轨迹训练中的梯度方差控制与贡献分配提供方法线索；但原文属纯 RL 理论，是否可迁移到 VLM 潜在推理需人工核查。

title: GLIMPSE: Global-Local Indexing with Multi-Precision Spectral Encoding for Explorable Video World Models
summary: A camera-controlled video world model must keep a scene consistent when the camera returns to it. Memories that render stored features into the target frame can turn depth and pose errors into ghosting or duplicated structure. Positional transport avoids that resampling by relocating a historical patch's address rather than its content, but assigns full positional precision even to inaccurate projections. We present GLIMPSE, a global-local memory interface with band-wise multi-precision coordinates and geometry-conditioned spectral attenuation to reduce sensitivity to inaccurate projected addresses. Local patch memory supplies view-specific appearance, while recurrent global memory provides scene context. Footprint-guided retrieval selects historical patches under a fixed local read budget. Under matched retrieval and read budgets, GLIMPSE improves geometric correspondence and photometric consistency over deterministic positional transport.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GLIMPSE，一种面向相机可控视频世界模型的全局-局部记忆接口：用分带多精度坐标与几何条件谱衰减，降低对不准确投影地址的敏感性，并以足迹引导的检索在固定读取预算下选取历史 patch。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「重定位历史 patch 地址而非重采样内容」及固定读取预算下的检索策略，可能为 LVR 中 latent 视觉记忆的预算分配、证据筛选与位置精度处理提供可核查的方法线索，但原论文并未涉及 VLM 推理。

title: Adaptive DHiSparse: Speculative Decoding over a Load-Adaptive KV Hierarchy
summary: Long-context serving runs out of KV memory before the hardware reaches its useful throughput. HiSparse stores history in host memory and fetches only the selected entries, but it uses one cache budget at every load and does not handle draft-model speculative decoding such as DSpark and DFlash2. We present Adaptive DHiSparse, which supports speculative decoding over hierarchical sparse KV and adapts residency to load. It protects the required working set, retains additional history while GPU memory is spare, and recovers the rest through exact fused retrieval. DSpark and DFlash2 keep their proposal and acceptance rules: queries share missing-row retrieval, draft KV uses a window-bounded ring, and verification staging is reused across layer groups. At 100K context and concurrency 128, GLM-5.3 with DFlash2 delivers 793 output tokens/s per decode GPU, 1.45$\times$ HiSparse and 1.27$\times$ non-speculative adaptive serving. Held to the same latency bounds as HiSparse, it sustains up to 4$\times$ the concurrency and 2.3 to 3.7$\times$ the output, depending on the per-token bound. On DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at 500K context and concurrency 512, Adaptive DHiSparse with DSpark delivers 1.85$\times$ the output of resident serving with DSpark. In a load step, optional residency reduces host fetches from 14.2% to 1.4% of selected rows at low load and releases memory under pressure.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Adaptive DHiSparse 这一长上下文服务系统：在分层稀疏 KV 之上支持 DSpark、DFlash2 等投机解码，并按负载自适应决定哪些 KV 常驻 GPU、哪些按需从主机精确融合检索，从而提升吞吐与并发。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按负载选择 KV 驻留与逐出、并以精确检索补回缺失行的机制，可作为核查「高负载或缓存受限时视觉 token 证据是否被保留在可访问状态」的线索；投机解码的提议—验证流程或可供参考 latent 轨迹的验证思路，但联系属推测，需核查原文。

title: State-Isolated Vision Mamba via Update-Tendency Routing for Underwater Image Enhancement
summary: Vision Mamba has recently emerged as an efficient alternative to convolutional and Transformer-based architectures by modeling long-range spatial dependencies through recurrent state evolution. Existing studies primarily improve token serialization, scanning strategies, or expert routing, yet largely overlook a state level question question: how should recurrent states be organized for spatially heterogeneous visual restoration? In this paper, we show that forcing tokens with heterogeneous update behaviors to recurrently modify a shared hidden state leads to persistent cross-content interference, which we term \textbf{State Contention}. We further argue that effective recurrent modeling should organize state evolution according to token compatibility rather than token ordering. Based on this observation, we introduce \textbf{State Isolation}, a new recurrent state organization principle for Vision Mamba,tokens with compatible state-update tendencies evolve within independent recurrent state streams. To instantiate this principle, we propose \textbf{IsoMamba}, a $Δ$-guided architecture that constructs model-intrinsic update representations, discovers update-compatible token groups through label-free clustering, and routes them to isolated Mamba experts following a \textbf{cluster--route--isolate} paradigm. In addition, we develop a dynamic channel-wise reweighting objective to compensate for wavelength-dependent reconstruction difficulty in underwater images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IsoMamba consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple underwater image enhancement benchmarks while providing cleaner hidden state responses, validating the effectiveness of state isolated recurrent modeling.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对 Vision Mamba 提出 State Isolation 原则与 IsoMamba：指出更新行为异构的 token 共享同一循环隐状态会造成「State Contention」干扰，因而用 Δ 引导的表示与无标签聚类，把相容 token 路由到相互隔离的循环状态流，用于水下图像增强。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按状态更新倾向对 token 分组、并用隔离的循环状态流避免共享隐状态相互干扰」的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态污染、信息坍缩与多流状态路由等具体问题。

title: LAPT-Scale: Scaling Embodied Policies with Latent Action Pre-Training on Human Videos
comment: Accepted at CoRL 2026; 24 pages including appendix
summary: Scaling generalist robotic policies is limited by the high cost of collecting embodied interaction data. Large-scale egocentric human videos offer a rich alternative, but they lack robot action labels, and existing action annotation methods are often noisy under real-world visual complexity and diverse manipulation dynamics. We introduce LAPT-Scale, a scalable latent action pre-training paradigm with two components: LAPT-Scale-LAM learns continuous latent actions by explaining frame-to-frame visual transitions in human videos and uses them as human-derived supervision, while LAPT-Scale-Policy trains a VLA policy through human-video latent-action pre-training, target-robot embodiment alignment, and task-specific post-training. Unlike prior vector-quantized LAMs, LAPT-Scale-LAM uses a continuous latent space to preserve fine-grained motion and interaction dynamics. We further combine perceptual, semantic, and optical-flow alignment signals to improve transition-level supervision beyond pixel reconstruction. Trained on 23.3K hours of egocentric video, LAPT-Scale-LAM provides implicit action supervision for policy pre-training, yielding consistent scaling gains and improving real-robot success from 63.3% to 85.0% as annotated human video scales from 1K to 5K hours. The learned policy also generalizes to unseen visual conditions.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LAPT-Scale：从 2.33 万小时第一人称人类视频中，通过解释帧间视觉转移学习连续 latent action，作为隐式动作监督预训练 VLA 策略，并结合本体对齐与任务后训练，在真机上随视频规模获得稳定增益。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作用连续 latent 空间替代向量量化以保留细粒度动态，并以感知、语义、光流对齐信号做转移级监督，这一「隐状态训练与监督信号设计」线索可能供核查 LVR 中 latent 表示的信息坍缩与视觉证据保留问题，但属机器人策略领域，需要较多迁移判断。

title: SafeDiSTL: Decomposing Joint Constraints for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Cooperative multi-agent tasks often impose constraints on a shared objective or collective safety. A team level violation cost function can measure this constraint outcome, but does not distinguish which agents' actions most strongly influence that violation. We present SafeDiSTL, a constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that allows for credit assignment even with joint constraint measurements. We use Signal Temporal Logic (STL) robustness to measure episode-level violation through running-maximum cost increments. Smooth full-episode robustness and differentiable dynamics provide action sensitivities, which allocate each cost increment across agents at the same decision time. These sensitivities account for delayed effects when weighting agents' shares of each cost increment. We study the framework in cooperative payload transport, connected navigation, and networked traffic control tasks. SafeDiSTL achieves 1.6-5.1x the safe-success rate in transport, improves navigation safe-success by 11.1%, and delivers 50-68% more throughput in traffic when compared to constrained baselines. Results demonstrate a strong improvement of the learned policy in dealing with shared constraint while retaining the performance of unconstrained policies.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SafeDiSTL：在只有团队级约束违反度量的合作多智能体强化学习中，用 STL 鲁棒性的平滑全轨迹值与可微动力学计算动作敏感度，把每个代价增量按敏感度分摊到各智能体，并处理延迟效应。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「仅有联合/结果级监督时用可微敏感度做信用分解并计入延迟效应」的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 步骤对最终答案的贡献分配与稀疏监督问题提供可核查的方法线索。

title: Studying the Effects of Task Diversity Using Small Mathematical Worlds
comment: 17 pages, 13 figures. Accepted for poster presentation at the NeurIPS 2026 MATH-AI Workshop
summary: Basic mathematical tasks like modular addition have been a valuable tool for illuminating aspects of neural network behavior that are challenging to see in noisy, unverifiable, large-scale, real-world settings. These studies have typically focused on a single task. However, modern language models are exposed to a vast number of tasks despite being trained with a next-token prediction objective. In this work, we introduce two mathematical task ecosystems, IntWorld and PermWorld, built from distinct but related tasks on integers and permutations. Both are designed to simulate task diversity within a cohesive mathematical 'world' where tasks are distinct but related. Because the datasets are procedurally generated, we can precisely vary the number of tasks, allowing us to begin to disentangle the role of task variety from other factors in training. After describing the datasets, we provide some initial results obtained from these datasets which support the idea that increasing task diversity increases the richness of a model's internal representations.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建 IntWorld 与 PermWorld 两个程序化生成的数学任务生态，通过精确控制任务数量，初步考察任务多样性对模型内部表示丰富度的影响。
AI.relevance_reason: 「程序化任务集控制变量 + 探测内部表示丰富度」这一做法，可能为核查 latent 推理状态中任务必要信息的保留、表示坍缩与任务多样性的关系提供测量与数据构造线索，需人工核查其探测手段。

title: Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training
summary: Training long-horizon language model agents requires assigning credit to intermediate decisions from sparse terminal feedback. Within a finite group of sibling rollouts, useful action comparisons depend on their context, evidence for both alternatives, and how that evidence enters learning. We propose Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization (MCGPO), a procedure for constructing weighted action preferences from already collected trajectories. MCGPO defines comparison contexts with pre-action state summaries and observed rubric progress, annotated by task rules. Two-action support selects among ordered exact and coarse matching rules. Fixed folds separate candidate decisions from the terminal outcomes used to orient their preferences, and support-dependent evidence weights scale an auxiliary pairwise objective alongside shared GraphGPO task learning. MCGPO reuses rollout data and each response's original history, preserving critic-free training. Across six environment-backbone settings with three training seeds each, MCGPO improves mean success over matched GraphGPO: by 0.47-1.46 percentage points on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B and 7B, and by 3.96 and 5.16 points on WebShop with Qwen3-4B and 8B. The ALFWorld gains build on baseline success above 92%, where remaining headroom is limited. Integrated success improves in three of four Qwen2.5 settings. Three-seed factorial controls support opposite-fold evidence and evidence weighting; joint state-rubric matching achieves the highest mean in all four representation-control settings.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MCGPO，从已采集轨迹中按匹配上下文（动作前状态摘要与 rubric 进展）构造加权的动作偏好，并用折叠分离候选决策与终端结果、按支持度加权辅助成对目标，在 ALFWorld、WebShop 等文本 agent 任务上提升成功率。

title: Neurons++: A Unified Visual-Stream Framework for Image and Video Reconstruction from fMRI with Neural-to-Visual Interpretability
summary: Decoding visual experience from fMRI is important for understanding human perception and developing brain-computer interfaces. Recent generative decoding methods can reconstruct plausible images and videos, but visual plausibility alone does not ensure that the output is faithfully grounded in brain activity. In this work, we propose Neurons++, a visual-stream fMRI reconstruction framework for both static image and dynamic video reconstruction. Compared with our conference version Neurons, Neurons++ extends the paradigm from video-only reconstruction to visual-stream reconstruction for both images and videos, and replaces parallel task conditioning with serial cortex-inspired decoding. The model first uses image-fMRI pretraining to obtain a stable spatial-semantic initialization, and then performs subject-specific fine-tuning for image and video reconstruction separately. The serial design organizes fMRI-derived representations into explicit spatial, semantic, language-level, and temporal cues. Extensive experiments show that Neurons++ achieves state-of-the-art video reconstruction and competitive image reconstruction across standard benchmarks. Beyond reconstruction fidelity, neural-to-visual analyses indicate that Neurons++ exhibits qualitative directional controllability under neural perturbation, that its fMRI encoder read-out is sensitive to stimulus-relevant cortical features, and that it supports ROI-guided semantic modulation. Code and model weights are available at: https://github.com/xmed-lab/NeuronsPlusPlus.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Neurons++，一个从 fMRI 重建静态图像与动态视频的统一视觉流框架：先用图像-fMRI 预训练获得空间语义初始化，再做受试者特异性微调，并以串行的、受皮层启发的解码将 fMRI 表征组织为空间、语义、语言和时间线索，配合神经扰动与 ROI 分析考察方向可控性和编码器读出。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「串行分阶段解码＋显式线索」的表示组织方式与神经扰动下的可控性、ROI 引导调制分析，可能为 LVR 中分阶段 latent 状态的构造与「答案是否真正使用 latent 内容」的因果核查提供可供核查的方法线索，但其本身并非推理研究。

title: READ: Reading the Selective Scan for Faithful Video Attribution
summary: Selective state-space models are an efficient approach to long-sequence video modeling. However, their recurrent computation makes it difficult to determine which video tokens drive a prediction. Existing attribution methods often require additional backward passes or repeated model evaluations, making them substantially more expensive than the forward inference they aim to explain. In this work, we introduce READ, a parameter-free attribution method for selective state-space models that unrolls the recurrence at the position read by the classifier. READ traces the contribution accumulated in the recurrent state back to the video tokens that contribute to the final prediction. By anchoring attribution at the classifier's readout, it produces a single spatiotemporal relevance map from which frame- and region-level relevance can be obtained directly. Despite requiring only one forward pass, READ achieves competitive faithfulness and localisation compared with substantially more expensive attribution methods. Experimental results show that READ avoids the systematic relevance biases of existing methods while recovering meaningful temporal and class-specific structure across datasets and backbones. More broadly, our results show that the recurrence underlying selective state-space models is not only an efficient mechanism for inference, but also a direct source of interpretable evidence for their predictions.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 READ，一种面向选择性状态空间模型（如 Mamba）的无参数归因方法：在分类器读出的位置展开循环，把累积在循环状态中的贡献回溯到视频 token，仅需一次前向即可得到时空相关性图。
AI.relevance_reason: 用单次前向把循环状态的贡献拆解回输入 token 的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态的贡献分配与视觉证据筛选问题，但其对象是视频归因而非多模态推理。

title: ReplaySSM: Cache SSM Inputs, Not State
comment: 11 pages (35 pages counting references and appendix), 6 figures, 2 tables. Code: https://github.com/Johnny-Liou/ReplaySSM
summary: State-space models (SSMs) maintain a fixed-size recurrent state, but reading and writing it at every decoding step can bottleneck hybrid models. This eager state management causes large state I/O with low arithmetic intensity, leaves speculative decoding no cheap rollback, and feeds state quantization error into subsequent recurrent updates. We introduce ReplaySSM, which unrolls the recurrence to represent the state as a checkpoint and a buffer of recent SSM inputs. This separates output computation from checkpoint updates. By updating the checkpoint periodically, ReplaySSM avoids state writes on most steps and roughly halves the dominant state memory traffic. Keeping recent inputs also makes speculative rollback a buffer-pointer operation and enables output-only verification without materializing intermediate states. The same separation allows a low-precision checkpoint to serve output computation on most steps while a higher-precision checkpoint serves recurrent updates, so rounding error in the low-precision copy never enters later updates. We implement ReplaySSM in vLLM for Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet. At serving batch size 256, it accelerates standard decoding by $1.20$--$1.47\times$ over a tuned vLLM baseline across four hybrid models, and delivers about $1.8\times$ the throughput of vLLM's speculative decoding on the two 120B-class models. Separate state precisions also reduce output KL divergence and downstream accuracy losses compared with a shared low-precision checkpoint.

AI.brief_summary: ReplaySSM 把 SSM 的循环状态表示为「检查点＋近期输入缓冲区」，从而在新解码步上避免状态写、以指针操作实现投机解码回滚，并用不同精度的检查点分别承担输出计算与循环更新，在 vLLM 中为 Mamba-2、Gated DeltaNet 带来加速与更低量化误差。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「从输入缓冲区重放状态」「输出计算与状态更新分离」「状态精度分层」等做法，可能为 latent/循环推理状态的缓存、更新与回滚提供可核查的方法线索；但论文聚焦推理服务效率，与视觉多模态推理无直接关联。

title: SimVTA: Simulation-Grounded Video-Trajectory Alignment for Driving World Action Models
summary: Driving world action models (WAMs) learn from paired trajectories and future observations. Post-training with reinforcement learning allows the policy to explore alternative trajectories and improve planning using driving rewards. However, driving logs contain future videos only for the recorded trajectories, leaving these alternatives without corresponding visual supervision. Thus, we introduce SimVTA, a simulation-grounded post-training framework that combines trajectory optimization with video supervision. First, we sample candidate trajectories for each observation and use a real-world simulator (e.g., World Engine) to render future videos for high-reward candidates in real-world scenes reconstructed with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). This provides trajectory-matched supervision independent of the model's own predictions. Under a limited rendering budget, we prioritize video supervision for higher-error futures among these rendered candidates. Finally, we optimize trajectory planning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and use a flow-matching loss on the matched videos to update shared representations. At inference time, the model predicts trajectories directly, without simulator calls. On NAVSIM v1, applying SimVTA to a WAM initialization improves PDMS from 86.2 to 91.3 (+5.1). It achieves 88.2 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 and an average HD-Score of 38.8 in closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM. Ablations show that updating shared representations with video supervision improves planning, while prioritizing higher-error futures among high-reward trajectories further improves performance.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SimVTA，一种面向驾驶世界动作模型的仿真落地后训练框架：对每条观测采样候选轨迹，用 3DGS 重建真实场景并由仿真器渲染高奖励候选的未来视频，再用 GRPO 优化轨迹规划、以 flow-matching 损失在匹配视频上更新共享表示；在 NAVSIM v1/v2 与 HUGSIM 上报告了规划指标提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「与模型自身预测无关的轨迹匹配视频监督」及「按误差优先分配渲染监督」的做法，可能为 LVR 的视觉潜状态是否保留任务必需信息、监督信号分配与表示坍缩问题提供可核查线索，但论文本身面向驾驶规划而非多模态推理。

title: UkrMeme: Multimodal Explainable Persuasion Detection in Ukrainian Memes
summary: Memes play a central role in modern online communication, especially in contexts of political conflict where visual and textual cues combine to convey persuasive messages. We study persuasive technique detection in Ukrainian memes using vision-language models (VLMs). We introduce UkrMeme, a dataset of 200 organically produced Ukrainian wartime memes annotated for persuasion techniques, and PTM-UA, a Ukrainian translation of a subset of the Propaganda 950 benchmark that preserves original visual content while translating meme text. We evaluate VLMs in a zero-shot prompting setup across image, text, and multimodal inputs using hierarchical F1 metrics. Finally, we compare Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) and model-generated token attributions and analyze the semantic categories of evidence emphasized by each explanation method.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建乌克兰战时梗图的说服技巧检测数据集 UkrMeme 与 Propaganda 950 的乌克兰语翻译子集 PTM-UA，在零样本提示下按图像、文本、多模态三种输入评测 VLM，并通过 LRP 与模型自生成 token 归因对比解释所强调证据的语义类别。
AI.relevance_reason: 其视觉与文本证据归因的对比方法可供核查：可能类比 LVR 中「答案是否真正使用视觉内容」与视觉旁路的诊断需求，但原文聚焦说服技巧检测与解释方法比较，未涉及 latent 推理状态。

title: Randomized Momentum Transport with Cheap Predictors
summary: Momentum methods such as STORM and second-order momentum track the gradient by adding a transport correction to momentum, at the cost of an extra oracle call per iteration. We introduce randomized momentum transport, which evaluates the correction with probability $q$ and otherwise uses a cheap prediction, with importance weighting that preserves the conditional mean and adds $(q^{-1}-1)$ times the prediction loss to the variance. Under transport-bias, second-moment, and residual-control assumptions, linear minimization oracle (LMO) updates, including normalized, sign, and exact spectral (Muon) directions, retain an $O(T^{-1/3})$ stationarity bound for each fixed $q>0$ with a single-gradient initialization. For unnormalized STORM, some $q<1$ lowers the leading coefficient of our sufficient gradient budget if and only if the gradient-difference noise modulus exceeds the smoothness constant, by at most about $10\%$. An online diagonal predictor admits a regret-to-convergence guarantee. At approximately equal oracle cost, querying a quarter of the corrections lowers the final training loss by $18$ to $43\%$ on MNIST1D and raises the test accuracy of Hessian-vector transport on CIFAR-10 by $1.5$ points.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出随机动量传输：以概率 q 用廉价预测器代替 STORM 类方法每步额外的梯度校正，用重要性加权保持条件均值并量化方差代价，在若干假设下给出 LMO 更新的 O(T^{-1/3}) 平稳性界与在线预测器的收敛保证，并在 MNIST1D、CIFAR-10 上验证降低成本的效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 「以廉价预测替代部分昂贵计算、再用重要性加权保持估计无偏」的机制，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK 的成本权衡（何时调用视觉证据、何时用 latent 预测推进状态）及贡献分配提供借鉴线索，但属另一领域的优化理论，迁移可行性需人工核查。

title: Spanning Diffusion and Flow-based Posterior Sampling via Exact Gaussian Conditioning
summary: Flow-matching and diffusion models are increasingly used as priors for linear inverse problems, however, most methods are bespoke to one class of trajectory prior. Plug-and-play methods have been proposed, however these implicitly decorrelate the guided trajectory, resulting in broad priors that can struggle when data is sparse. This work proposes $β$-Flow: a general plug-and-play method indexed by a correlation parameter $β$ that generalises over flow, diffusion, and decorrelated priors, and a confidence parameter $κ$ that controls how strongly the path distribution is enforced. Each step requires only one forward evaluation of a denoising network, followed by a Gaussian conditioning step. This step is an exact Kalman update that is not dependent on network gradients. We show that many existing guided samplers can be interpreted as instances or approximations of our method, each implicitly using a different trajectory prior and operator in place of the Kalman gain. From this viewpoint, we provide a qualitative comparison of methods in terms of their implicit biases and assumptions. We demonstrate consistently state-of-the-art level performance across 7 inverse problems over 4 datasets in terms of PSNR and SSIM. Moreover, we demonstrate the utility of this prior control, by showing that confident high correlations (strict priors) work best when observations are less informative, while low correlation is preferred when observations are more informative, reflecting the complementary roles of the prior and likelihood in Bayesian inference.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 β-Flow：一种以相关系数 β 和置信度 κ 参数化的 plug-and-play 后验采样方法，每步只需一次去噪网络前向加一步精确 Kalman 式高斯条件更新，可统一 flow、diffusion 与去相关先验，并在 4 数据集 7 个线性逆问题上取得较好表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其不依赖梯度的精确高斯条件更新，或可作为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态条件更新与证据注入的方法线索；β 所刻画的先验—似然权衡也可能对应「视觉证据可信度 vs latent 推理先验」的平衡，但用于多模态推理状态尚需核查。

title: Shared Canonical Component Removal Beyond Expert Views
summary:
In clinical practice, experts often begin by converting raw inputs into a set of expert features before making a decision. While black-box models trained on raw input can outperform models trained on expert views, it remains unclear what predictive signal the raw model exploits beyond what the expert view captures. We introduce an audit framework to quantify this gap using Shared Canonical Component Removal (SCCR). Unlike standard residualization or concept erasure, SCCR selectively removes only those directions strongly shared between learned raw and expert embeddings.
  Evaluations on synthetic data, coronary artery disease (CAD) detection, antidepressant treatment dropout prediction, and skin lesion classification using SkinCon annotations show that SCCR identifies the ways in which expert views are insufficient and recovers residual predictive signal while minimizing redundancy with the expert view.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Shared Canonical Component Removal（SCCR）审计框架，选择性地移除 learned raw embeddings 与 expert embeddings 之间强共享的方向，以量化 raw 模型在专家特征之外仍利用的残余预测信号，并在合成数据、CAD 检测、抑郁治疗脱落预测和皮肤病变分类上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「移除两表示间共享方向、保留残余信号」的做法，可能可供核查是否能用于检验 latent 推理状态相对视觉旁路是否携带额外信息，属方法借鉴线索而非已验证结论。

title: On the Design Space of Continuous Diffusion Language Models
summary: Continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) promise to bring the benefits of continuous flow modelling to language, including accelerated sampling and controllable generation. The field has grown rapidly, and the capabilities of CDLMs have begun to rival those of discrete diffusion. Yet, unlike for continuous modalities such as images or videos, our grasp of the levers that matter when training CDLMs remains limited. In this work, we focus on two of these levers, namely self-conditioning and embedding geometry, and shed light on some of the mechanisms behind them, which in turn suggest cheaper and more effective designs. We begin by showing that self-conditioning corrects a train/inference mismatch by exposing the model to inference-like states that are otherwise rare during training. These gains can be recovered without an extra forward pass by a two-level interpolant, coined $\mathrm{DoubleCat}$, which improves TinyGSM accuracy more than threefold. Self-conditioning also aids in recognising tokens dominated by large-norm Gaussians$\unicode{x2013}$an issue known as token identifiability. To address it directly, we introduce discrete reveals to $\mathrm{DoubleCat}$, yielding $\mathrm{SemiCat}$, which achieves discrete diffusion-level performance on TinyGSM, reaching $49.94\%$ with standard training hyperparameters and a tuned sampler. At the $1.7$B scale, $\mathrm{SemiCat}$ outperforms discrete diffusion on four of six likelihood-based evaluations, and surpasses one-hot flows on unconditional generation. On embedded spaces, we find that cross-entropy drives embeddings towards a geometry whose decoding error rate closely matches the one-hot one. We briefly explore a range of further options, such as hybrid corruption processes and noise schedules, including asynchronous ones. We believe this exploration can help the community better understand and advance the design space of CDLMs.

AI.brief_summary: 论文系统考察连续扩散语言模型的设计空间，聚焦 self-conditioning 与嵌入几何两个因素，并提出 DoubleCat、SemiCat 等更省算力的改进设计。
AI.relevance_reason: 其连续扩散状态迭代与 self-conditioning 缓解训练/推理状态错配的机制，可能为 LVR 中 diffusion 或 loop 方式生成、更新 latent 推理状态提供方法线索，嵌入几何分析亦可供核查，但迁移到多模态推理需较多验证。

title: Returning to Development States: When Full Sandbox Snapshots Help Coding Agents
comment: 7 pages, 6 figures. Preprint. Not peer reviewed
summary: Coding agents often make useful progress before they fail, but retry-from-scratch discards the machine state created along the way. This makes failure recovery an interesting search problem: if intermediate environment states preserve meaningful progress, restoring and branching from them could outperform repeatedly restarting from the initial state. We implement Go-Explore-style search over full Daytona snapshots and find that higher and more efficient solve rates depend mainly on progress that sits outside the repository, such as databases, services, and other runtime state. Our results suggest that full-snapshot search is most effective when long-horizon coding work spans multiple services whose state cannot be reconstructed from a single diff.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 Daytona 完整沙箱快照上实现 Go-Explore 式搜索，让 coding agent 从中间环境状态恢复并分支，以替代从头重试；结果发现解题率提升主要来自仓库之外的运行时状态（数据库、服务等）。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「从快照恢复并分支搜索、有效进度可能位于可见 diff 之外」的做法，或可作为 LVR 中状态回滚/分支搜索与「哪些内部状态成分承载有效推理进度」评估的借鉴线索，可核查其向 latent 状态搜索迁移的可行性；但对象是软件环境状态而非多模态内部表示，联系较间接。

title: Event-based Action Recognition by Pre-Training on Multi-Frame Representations
summary: Action recognition is a crucial task in domains like robotics, patient monitoring, or surveillance. Recently, event-based action recognition has attracted much attention due to the event camera's ability to capture fast motions and its improved privacy over conventional vision cameras. While frame-based event representations work well for short event sequences, their discriminative ability declines sharply with longer and more complex event sequences. In this work, we introduce a multi-frame representation that greatly improves recognition performance over its single-frame counterpart. We adopt a masked auto-encoding framework to pre-train a Vision Transformer using a sparsity-aware masking algorithm and token selection mechanism to improve downstream performance and control computational complexity. We also introduce multiple mask tokens for the decoder with a position-aware attention mechanism, leading to further improved performance. Our proposed method shows impressive performance for challenging long-duration and complex event sequences, yielding state-of-the-art performance on THU-EACT-50 CHL and DailyDVS-200.

AI.brief_summary: 论文面向事件相机的动作识别，提出多帧事件表示，并用掩码自编码框架预训练 Vision Transformer，结合稀疏感知掩码、token 选择机制和多 mask token 位置感知注意力解码器，在长时复杂事件序列上取得 SOTA。
AI.relevance_reason: 其稀疏感知掩码与 token 选择如何按稀疏度和计算预算取舍视觉 token，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与动态计算分配提供可核查线索，但任务本身与 VLM latent 推理无直接关系。

title: LapMerge: Differentiable Exact-Budget Token Merging in Linear Time
summary: Modern vision and language models process ever longer token sequences, and reducing them is the main lever on downstream cost. Token compression, however, faces a fundamental trade-off: selecting tokens discards information, while existing merging methods preserve it only through pairwise token-to-token matching or $MN$ token-to-output interactions. We introduce LapMerge, a differentiable merging operator that resolves this trade-off for ordered sequences: a learned mass distribution partitions the sequence into exactly $N$ equal-mass segments under a Laplace-kernel density, and prefix/suffix scans aggregate each segment, so both the forward and the backward pass run in $\mathcal{O}(M+N)$ time. This combination - an exact output budget, end-to-end differentiability, and linear cost - is precisely what previous reducers trade off against one another. The budget can be changed without changing operator parameters, and the learned mass doubles as a token-level map of where the budget is allocated. Across vision and vision-language tasks, LapMerge matches or improves on strong token reducers while being up to two orders of magnitude faster at large sequence lengths; it is particularly effective when token order reflects spatial or temporal locality, and works both as a drop-in reduction module and as a trainable architectural component.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LapMerge：在 Laplace 核密度下用可学习的质量分布把有序 token 序列切成恰好 N 个等质量片段，再以前缀/后缀扫描聚合，实现精确输出预算、端到端可微且前后向均为 O(M+N)，在视觉与视觉-语言任务上匹配或优于现有 token reducer，长序列下快至两个数量级。
AI.relevance_reason: 其可微合并与「学习到的质量分布即可视为 token 级预算分配图」可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、压缩后细节保留与动态计算预算分配提供可核查的方法线索；但论文本身面向通用效率压缩，未涉及 latent 推理状态或生成机制，故不属主线。

title: RATED: Reliability-Aware AI Agent Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics
summary: As AI agents increasingly rely on external tools, accurate retrieval is essential for reliable behavior. Existing methods optimize semantic relevance but largely ignore tool availability during execution. To address this gap, we propose RATED (Reliability-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics), a retrieval framework that combines robust semantic matching with dynamic reliability adaptation. RATED employs a frozen dual-encoder with contrastive fine-tuning for semantic matching, and a lightweight contextual bandit module that re-ranks candidates based on real-time execution feedback. This design enables rapid adaptation to runtime tool failures without expensive model retraining. We introduce EcoAgent, a benchmark of 5,172 real-world tools and over 210,000 query-tool pairs for offline retrieval and dynamic reliability evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that RATED achieves a 52.2% relative MRR improvement over the ToolLLM API retriever on real-world queries, and reduces fault selection rate from 86.2% to 2.9% under severe API outage scenarios with a 30% failure rate, while incurring negligible latency overhead of less than 1 ms over encode-only inference. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Elliotes/EcoAgent.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RATED 工具检索框架：用冻结双编码器做语义匹配，再用轻量 contextual bandit 依据运行时执行反馈对候选重排，并发布含 5172 个工具、21 万余 query-tool 对的 EcoAgent 基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用执行反馈在线重排、无需重训模型即适应工具失效」的机制，可能为 LVR 中依据证据可靠性动态选择是否继续 LOOK/何时 STOP 提供方法线索，能否迁移到视觉证据筛选可供核查。

title: Hide and Seek: HIDE Concepts to SEEK explanations for black box models
summary: Interpreting machine learning model predictions is a central challenge, particularly for black-box vision models. Concept-based attribution methods interpret models using human-understandable concepts. Existing concept-based methods can only interpret classification and regression models. They require access to model weights or large concept-annotated datasets, and most methods cannot provide image-level attribution. We propose Hide and Seek (HnS), a new method for concept-level attribution that does not require access to model weights or labeled concept datasets. HnS can interpret a wide range of vision models. Given a concept and image set, HnS retrieves concept-aligned images using a vision-language model, localizes the concept within each image, masks the localized region, and measures attribution from the change in the black-box model's output between the original and masked images. This enables faithful attribution by directly measuring the model's behavior and supporting local attributions. We validated HnS on CelebA and COCO-Stuff. Compared to existing methods, HnS showed better agreement with ground-truth attributions. We demonstrated the applicability of HnS on diverse tasks, including image captioning and satellite image segmentation, where no existing concept attribution method can be used. We provided our anonymous code in the supplementary material.

title: InstantFusion: A Shared Latent Interface for Heterogeneous Image Generators
summary: Diffusion/flow models have emerged as the de facto paradigms for image generation, giving rise to a diverse family of modern generators with increasingly heterogeneous architectures and representations. Despite their remarkable generation capabilities, the cross-model alignment of latent representations and the consistency of their underlying denoising dynamics remain underexplored. In this work, we uncover an intriguing cross-model compatibility: independently trained generators exhibit similar latent spatial organization, while directly handing off intermediate states between unaligned models can still preserve coarse visual content. Motivated by these observations, we propose InstantFusion, a lightweight shared latent interface that connects the denoising trajectories of heterogeneous image generators. Specifically, to enable flexible cross-model state translation, model-specific Latent AutoEncoders (LAEs) are introduced to project intermediate states from different generators into a shared latent space and decode them into the latent space of a target generator. This shared space is constrained by two complementary objectives: aligning intermediate states derived from the same image at matched noise levels and synchronizing their corresponding local denoising velocities. Once trained, InstantFusion allows denoising to seamlessly transition across frozen generators without requiring a dedicated mapping for every model pair. The versatility of InstantFusion is demonstrated across acceleration, multi-preference composition, cross-architecture on-policy distillation, and cross-model composition, achieving competitive performance across these diverse settings.

AI.brief_summary: 论文观察到独立训练的扩散/流模型具有相似的潜空间组织，据此提出 InstantFusion：用各模型专属的 Latent AutoEncoder 把中间去噪状态投影到共享潜空间并解码到目标模型的潜空间，以「同图同噪声水平的状态对齐」和「局部去噪速度同步」两个目标训练，从而在冻结的异构生成器之间直接切换去噪轨迹。
